poses.caption: Hold a forearm side plank with feet stacked or staggered and hips in a straight line for 20–30 seconds, then switch sides.

jobs.detail: FOREARM SIDE PLANK v2, ONE static full-body hold, front-side three-quarter view. LEFT forearm flat on thin gray mat elbow under shoulder, forearm forward palm flat. Both legs STRAIGHT extended and feet slightly STAGGERED allowed by canonical record: both shoe outer edges grounded, top right foot slightly ahead of bottom left foot. HIPS elevated with clear white gap under pelvis/thigh/shorts; straight head-shoulder-HIP-heel line, no knee bend/sag. RIGHT hand on right hip, neck neutral gaze forward. Only forearm and shoes floor support. Primary abdominal region ONE soft diffuse BLURRED red tint over intact black side/front shirt, no rays/fibers/sixpack divisions in fabric. Fine exposed arms/calves grayscale, opaque clothes all surfaces. No bench/ball.

poses.caption: Tilt the head gently toward one shoulder, resting that hand lightly on the opposite side of the head; keep shoulders relaxed and hold 15–30 seconds, then switch sides.

jobs.detail: GENTLE HAND-ASSISTED SIDE NECK STRETCH, ONE static full-body FRONT view. Stand tall feet hip width, torso/pelvis vertical, shoulder line LEVEL relaxed. FACE/nose looks straight FORWARD camera, NO head turning. Tilt whole HEAD toward MODEL RIGHT which is IMAGE LEFT about20degrees, RIGHT ear toward RIGHT shoulder, eye/ear line visibly DIAGONAL. RIGHT hand comes gently OVER crown of head and rests LIGHTLY on LEFT side above left ear (IMAGE RIGHT), fingertips light, right elbow out, NO forceful pull. LEFT arm hangs by side, LEFT shoulder remains down away from ear. Chin neutral neither up nor tucked, NO torso side bend. Primary LEFT levator scapulae regional teaching highlight on stretched IMAGE-RIGHT posterolateral neck between upper inner shoulder and upper neck, small red elongated patch on EXPOSED neck ONLY, stop at intact black shirt neckline, no fabric removed to expose deep muscles. All other exposed anatomy fine detailed grayscale. Hair away from neck, full opaque shirt/shorts seat/crotch, entire model within margin.
